motion-capture-suit.context: A standing figure in a fitted body suit with round marker dots on its elbows and knees. Used for motion capture, performance capture, game and film animation and biomechanics.

facial-capture-helmet.context: A head in profile wearing a helmet with a thin boom arm that holds a small camera in front of the face. Used for facial performance capture in film, games and animation.

led-volume-stage.context: A curved wall of LED screens showing a mountain scene with a small camera on a tripod in front. Used for virtual production, in camera visual effects and film backdrops.

photogrammetry-scan.context: A small object in the centre with a ring of cameras around it all pointing inward. Used for 3D scanning, photogrammetry and building models from many photos.

exposure-triangle.context: A triangle linking an aperture circle, a shutter dial and a square sensitivity badge at its three corners. Used for photography lessons on manual exposure settings.

iso-sensitivity.context: A rounded badge with the letters ISO above a row of grain dots. Used for camera sensitivity settings and noise or grain controls.

exposure-bracketing.context: Three photo frames fanned out like cards with a minus, a dot and a plus beneath them. Used for auto exposure bracketing and HDR capture settings.

burst-mode.context: A row of overlapping photo frames offset to the right with short speed lines on the left. Used for burst, continuous shooting and rapid fire capture settings.

high-speed-photography.context: A milk drop crown splash with small droplets above it and a flat surface beneath. Used for high speed and liquid splash photography and freeze motion effects.

light-leak.context: A photo frame with a glow of curved bands spilling in from the top right corner. Used for the light leak film effect, vintage filters and overexposed edges.

film-grain.context: A photo frame filled with an even speckle of small dots of different sizes. Used for grain, noise and analog film texture effects.

sepia-tone.context: A photo frame with mountains and a sun beside a single tint drop. Used for sepia, vintage and brown toned photo filters.

moire-pattern.context: Two sets of concentric rings offset against each other so they overlap into a lattice. Used for moire and interference pattern warnings in photos, screens and printing.

rolling-shutter-distortion.context: A three bladed propeller with bent curved blades inside a camera frame. Used for rolling shutter skew, wobble and jello distortion warnings in video.

motion-photo.context: A photo frame with a small play circle and wave arcs on both sides. Used for live photos, moving pictures and photos that include a short video clip.

night-mode-photo.context: A camera outline with a crescent moon and a small star inside. Used for night mode, low light and long exposure photo settings.

photo-filters.context: A photo frame holding three overlapping circles in a Venn arrangement. Used for photo filters, color effects and presets in image editors and camera apps.

switch-camera.context: A camera outline with two curved arrows chasing each other in a circle inside its body. Used for flipping between front and back cameras in photo and video apps.

photo-collage.context: A square frame divided into several photo panels of different sizes. Used for collage makers, photo grids, mosaics and multi photo layouts.

eye-autofocus.context: An eye with a round pupil inside four corner focus brackets. Used for eye detection autofocus, face tracking focus and portrait focus modes.

red-eye-reduction.context: An eye with a solid pupil beside a small lightning flash. Used for red eye reduction, pre flash and eye fix tools in cameras and photo editors.

dodge-and-burn.context: A round paddle on a stick beside a hand shaped card with a hole in the palm. Used for the dodge and burn lighten and darken tools in darkrooms and photo editors.

clone-stamp-tool.context: A rubber stamp tool beside a small crosshair target. Used for the clone stamp, copy pixels, healing and duplicate area tools in image editors.

curves-adjustment.context: A square graph with a centre cross and an S shaped curve rising from bottom left to top right. Used for tone curve, contrast and color grading controls.

levels-adjustment.context: A histogram hill above a row with three triangle slider handles. Used for levels, black point, white point and tonal range controls in photo editors.

noise-reduction.context: A photo frame with speckle dots on the left and a smooth side on the right divided by a sweeping line. Used for denoise, grain removal and clean up tools for high ISO images.

darkroom-tray.context: A shallow developing tray seen at an angle with a photo print inside and tongs resting on the rim. Used for darkroom processing, film photography and print development.

film-changing-bag.context: A flat lightproof bag with a zipper across the top and two sleeve openings on the sides. Used for loading film in daylight and film photography workflows.

slide-loupe.context: A cone shaped magnifier with a wide eyepiece rim standing on a small square slide. Used for reviewing slides and negatives on a light table.

medium-format-film-roll.context: A short spool of film wrapped in backing paper with a tape tab, seen from the side. Used for 120 film, medium format and film photography.

110-film-cartridge.context: A flat film cartridge with two chambers joined by a narrow bridge with a small window. Used for 110 pocket film, subminiature cameras and vintage film formats.

sheet-film-holder.context: A flat holder for sheet film with a dark slide pulled half out of one end. Used for large format, 4x5 and view camera photography.

instant-film-pack.context: A box pack of instant photo prints with the top print leaning out of it showing its picture window. Used for instant film, instant cameras and print refills.

daguerreotype.context: A small hinged case opened like a book with an oval frame holding a portrait on one side. Used for early photography, antique portraits and photo history.

iris-transition.context: A dark frame with a small circular opening in the centre showing a figure, like a closing iris wipe. Used for iris out, silent film and cartoon ending transitions in video editors.

rain-machine.context: A tall stand holding a horizontal pipe bar that sprays rows of slanted rain lines down to the ground. Used for rain towers and weather effects on film sets and stages.

stunt-airbag.context: A large puffy cushion on the ground with a figure falling toward it. Used for stunt falls, safety landings and film stunt work.

ptz-camera-controller.context: A desk control panel with a tall joystick on the right, a row of buttons and a small screen on the left. Used for pan tilt zoom camera control in broadcast, church and live streaming.

sound-stage.context: A large arched hangar studio building with a big sliding door and a number above it. Used for film studios, soundstage rentals and production lot locations.

probe-lens.context: A small camera body with a very long thin tube lens that bends to an angled tip. Used for periscope, snorkel and macro probe lenses in food, insect and product photography.
